name: mcp-azure
description: Azure DevOps Server tools for Claude: pull requests, work items, YAML pipelines, search, wikis and repo files, through the ado-mcp binary (self-hosted, PAT auth). Writes always ask first.

ado_pat.title: Azure DevOps personal access token
ado_pat.description: PAT with Code (Read & Write), Work Items (Read & Write), Build (Read & Execute), Project and Team (Read), Wiki (Read), Test Management (Read).

binPath.title: ado-mcp binary
binPath.description: Path to the ado-mcp binary. Default: ado-mcp on PATH.
